install: npm install --no-save @playwright/mcp@latest playwright@latest && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && node environment/scripts/patch-playwright-mcp-headless.js && chmod +x environment/scripts/*.sh && mkdir -p /opt/playwright-chromium && rsync -a --delete --exclude .git ./ /opt/playwright-chromium/ && PW_CHROMIUM_ROOT=/opt/playwright-chromium node environment/scripts/patch-playwright-mcp-headless.js
start: bash /opt/playwright-chromium/environment/scripts/generate-secrets.sh || bash environment/scripts/generate-secrets.sh; chmod +x /opt/playwright-chromium/environment/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || chmod +x environment/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true
